column1: # Lane stores (repository, clone and git stores, their caches and updates)

column3: n/a: Dexie/IndexedDB schema upgrades that delete duplicate GitHub repository and owner rows; Corvene stores the repository list as one JSON value in redb (corvene_store), with each GitHub repository embedded in its Repository and no repository, GitHub repository or owner tables, row ids or versioned upgrades

column2: RepositoriesStore › updating a GitHub repository › reuses an existing GitHub repository
column3: n/a: compares the IndexedDB row id (gitHubRepository.dbID) two repositories share; Corvene embeds a copy of the GitHubRepository in each Repository and has no GitHub repository table or row id

column2: CloningRepository › identity › generates a hash from the repository identity
column3: n/a: CloningRepository.hash (`${id}+${path}+${url}`) is the equality key GitHub Desktop compares (React keys in app.tsx, the app store's selected-repository checks) to tell whether the object changed; Corvene's CloneState is compared with PartialEq (clones are told apart by CloneState::id) and has no hash string

deviation: deviations.md › GitHub layer › Forks: "The remote URL is not rewritten when the API reports a renamed repository (GHD `updateRemoteUrl`)"; not switchable (the bullet's flag 303-fork-before-push only gates the fork offer), and Corvene has no updateRemoteUrl or other remote rewrite after a repository refresh to test
